notes.title: ⚔️ GAME UPDATE! Patch Notes — Version 1.5: “MINOR MADNESS? MAJOR UPGRADES.”
notes.notes:
🛒 NEW APOCALYPSE SHOP PAGE: "MINOR MADNESS"

Oh, you thought the Shop with TEARS was done? NOPE.
Unlock this page and start buying upgrades that scale forever (or until your sanity breaks).



🔪 THREAT EROSION

"Apocalyptic Threat HP? More like Apocalyptic Threat... less HP."

Permanently reduce Threat HP by +0.2% per level (stacks, because why not).


"Wait, isn’t this just cheating?" Shhh, it’s strategic long-term suffering.



👻 SPIRIT POWER

"Anyone could be the Spirit Barrage user in here!" 

Boost Spirit Barrage power by +1% per level (cumulative, because math is fun). 

You’ll notice this around level 50. Or maybe not. Just punch the s**t out of the bag.



🧩 TL;DR

New "Minor Madness" page in Apocalypse Shop: long-term scaling upgrades!

Erode Threat HP or buff Spirit Barrage—forever.

The Shop is now officially a conspiracy board. Embrace it.

"Click now. Think later. The numbers only go up."

notes.title: 🎥 GAME UPDATE! Patch Notes — Version 1.4: “ABSOLUTE CINEMA(tic)"
notes.notes:
🎥🥊 SECRET UNLOCK: JOHN PUNCH
Yup, that's the cinematic thingie. Aaaaand you don’t buy this one, you earn it.

Get 100+ Purified Apocalypse Tears and something... changes.
"Oh, yeah!" and a new button appears. And if you click it... 

Plays a video (animated by yours truly).

At the end: either huge damage (in Eternal Gate) or a flood of Tears (outside it).

Damage scales with Prestige, Transcendence, and your total Apocalypse Tears.

Cooldown: 24 hours. Let the guy rest.

It’s dumb. It’s strong. You’ll love it!
[hr][/hr]
🔥 FURY MODE — NOW IN THE APOCALYPSE SHOP (AND THAT'S TWO)
You can now permanently unlock Fury, just like the Spirit Barrage. And the extra levels get you even further beyond the Max Level! Higher levels = faster charge.

Also:

Drain is a bit faster now (feels better).

Charging is smoother and more responsive.

Works great with other ability boosts.

It needed a bit of QoL to combo with the Power Punch, yup. Golden Time needs to be charged.

Speaking of which...
[hr][/hr]
💛 GOLDEN TIME — NOW IN THE APOCALYPSE SHOP (AAAND THAT'S THREE)
PERMANENT GOLDEN TIME, LET'S GOOOOOOOOOOO (biggest fan of this update).

Now in the Apocalypse Shop you can boost Golden Time's multipliers.
Level it up. Enjoy the tear value!
[hr][/hr]
🧩 TL;DR

New Apocalypse Shop over-upgrades: Fury and Golden Time

Hidden ability: John Punch (100+ Apo. Tears)

Fury now feels snappier, faster, and more worth it.

The Apocalypse Shop is getting full. The upgrades are getting weirder... good.

It's time to Click to Punch.

notes.title: ☁️ Patch Notes – Version 1.3.3 “Save Yourself (Automatically)”
notes.notes:
💾 AutoSave is here!
Your game now automatically saves every 5 minutes! Stress no more!


🌩️ Steam Cloud Support
Your progress now follows you across devices.
Punch at home. Punch at work. Punch in the ETERNAL GATE OF DARKNESS. Or in the bathroom.

notes.title: 🔓 Patch Notes – Version 1.3.2 “Gate’s Open Early!”
notes.notes:
⚙️ Eternal Gate: Now Available at Trascendence 10
The Eternal Gate no longer waits for Trascendence 20.
You can now enter the fight at Trascendence 10!

...which means more Apocalyptic Threats and way more Apocalypse Tears, sooner.

notes.title: ⚙️ Patch Note 1.3.1 - "Smooth Baby"
notes.notes:
✨ What’s New:
Performance boost!
Tear generation now causes less lag, even during intense punching frenzies.

Tear limit:
You can now have up to 250 Tears on screen.
Once the cap is reached, any new Tears are auto-collected instantly. No tears, no problem.
[hr][/hr]TL;DR:
Faster. Cleaner. Smarter Tears. Your GPU says thanks.

notes.title: 🔥⛩️🔥 MAJOR UPDATE! Patch Notes — Version 1.3: “the Eternal Gate”
notes.notes:
A massive new mode, permanent upgrades, new flaming buttons, and yes… the bag fights back (kinda).
[hr][/hr]💀 ETERNAL GATE: The Real Challenge Begins (Trascendence 20+)
Enter the Eternal Gate: a standalone mode unlocked at Trascendence 20.
Fight a corrupted, furious version of the bag in a 60-second boss battle.

Collecting Tears doesn’t fill your bank anymore: it damages the Apocalyptic Threat (it's still the Bag).

Fail? You’re kicked back to training in John's room.

Win? You earn an APOCALYPSE TEAR (Corrupted).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606025/91809f8c95ffdf0046df3b3da4263f5e07cf6483.png"]

Every cleared level raises the challenge. The Threat will have more HP, so you need to make it cry harder.
Aaaand each new level grants you more Apocalypse Tears. (Level 7 = 7 Apo. Tears, for example.)

Once you Transcend, all collected corrupted tears become Purified Apocalypse Tears.

These Purified Tears give you a Tear Value bonus... and can be spent. Where, you ask? 

In the...


[hr][/hr]🛒 APOCALYPSE SHOP: Spend Forever Wisely
Introducing The Apocalypse Shop, where your hard-earned purified Tears go.

Here’s what’s in stock (for now):

Extra Tears per punch (stackable and permanent!)

Extra Tear Value (yes, additive. yes, forever.)

VACUUM POWER UPGRADE: Tears vacuumed with Auto Clear now deal bonus damage in Eternal Gate. Wild.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606025/6af6b6aec91d933b9c2ee1db86baa80617a10c56.png"]
[hr][/hr]🌈 Tier Chances Up? FOREVER.
That’s right — you can now permanently increase the chance of generating colored Tears (Silver, Gold, Ruby, etc.) even right after a fresh Prestige or Transcendence.

Want Emerald Tears at Prestige 1? Just buy the bonus.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606025/82706c98a9992e542317265d1575226f3bd1429c.png"]
[hr][/hr]⚡ Abilities Get Stronger FOREVER
The new Ability Boosters let you add +1 permanent level to key abilities, like:

Super Barrage
Even after a reset, the skill stays unlocked.
Stack it to go beyond the normal max level.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606025/49db6705845392cc5413dc403fe872036e12a856.png"]
[hr][/hr]🌋 NEW TRANSCENDENCE UPGRADES:
Two fresh late-game powerups await you:

Supreme Power Punch (Trascendence 8+)
Your Power Punch now generates MAX-tier tears. Every. Single. Time.

Max Fury (Trascendence 6+)
Instant full Fury bar on use, with a short cooldown.
[hr][/hr]🧼 QoL & UI:
Beach Mode button moved to John’s Shop (Page 5)

Shop Pages now have icon buttons instead of numbers — so you know what’s where

Mute button now also works with Beach and Golden Time music

Colored Tear shop finally doesn’t overlap anymore with other buttons (hooray!)
[hr][/hr]TL;DR:
A whole new game mode

Permanent power upgrades

Quality-of-life boosts

Time to click like a god.

You may want to Enter the Eternal Gate and...

Click to Punch.

notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE! PATCH 1.2 - "Beach, Please"
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - Version 1.2 — “Beach, Please!”



I've decided to add some upgrades that will stay FOREVER.

Yes, your runs are now permanently buffed, baby.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606025/a80c9386dc5ee555926da9f4a5d97420cd4d5aa1.png"]

🌀 ETERNAL POWER: Weak Spot Unleashed
Transcendence now unlocks Eternal Upgrades! 





First up: Weak Spot.


It’s not just a math bonus, it’s a minigame! 
Hit the glowing red mark in time and you'll generate an explosion of max-tier Tears like never before.
Cooldown-based. High reward. Get good.



🎵 NEW: Permanent Background Themes + Visuals
Every unlocked episode now comes with its own background art and music... and they’re permanent once earned!


Switch up your vibe. Let your punches hit on beat.



CLICK TO PUNCH - BEACH EPISODE THEME



EPISODE 1 -> 🌴 BEACH EPISODE: For the Chill Grinders
Unlockable via Transcendence, Beach Mode gives you the highest passive Tear generation yet.
Less clicking, more sipping.
The soundtrack? Sunny. The gains? Soaked in value.

EPISODE 2 -> ??? (comment!)





Smaller Update/QoL: Offline Production Tracker
You can now check how many Tears Lil John earned while you were away in his Shop Page!
Yes, he kept punching. Yes, since the first patch. Yes, he’s tired.
But you’re rich now.

notes.title: NEW GAME CONTENT! PATCH NOTE 1.1 - "NEXT LEVEL PRESTIGE"
notes.notes:
NEW GAME CONTENT! PATCH NOTE 1.1 - "NEXT LEVEL PRESTIGE"

New Features:
🔥 Fury Mode (Prestige 5+) - Build fury during barrages to enter auto-punch mode! The angrier you get, the longer you punch.

Trascendence Additions:
✨ Divine Bag (Trascendence 4+) - Unlock the sacred bag that makes ALL tears golden and doubles their value!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606025/fb7bb55d48bcbd3f5ef7cc30cd246d803c80d62f.png

Prestige Power-ups:
💥 Enhanced Abilities - Prestiging now unlocks upgrades for your prestige abilities:

 Spirit Barrage now can get even more powerful
 Special Power Punch now can charge GOLDEN TIME faster
 Fury (new feature) can get even faster in the auto-clicking mode
 GOLDEN TIME can get even stronger multipliers


Balance Changes:
⚖️ Tiered Tears Economy Rework: adjusted upgrade costs for Silver→Rainbow tears

"The gods of punching have blessed your journey with divine upgrades!"

notes.title: NEW GAME CONTENT! PATCH NOTE 1.0 - "TRASCEND THIS"
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - Version 1.0 — “Transcend This!”

🧪 Tiered Tears Rebalanced
The tier system for Tears has been reworked!Now each tier (Silver, Gold, Ruby, etc.) has better scaling, adjusted unlock levels, and more meaningful drop chances. Upgrading feels smoother and each new tier adds real punch to your grind.

🥊 Lil John Upgrades (Auto-Puncher)

Lil John just got a glow-up!

More Tears per Punch: His fists now hit harder! Each auto-punch generates more Tears.

Critical Hits: Unlocked critical strike chance! Occasionally, Lil John will... kick?! It will generate double Tears. Watch those numbers fly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606025/03106c020a776c2036fea5fdf474f7cc8e10d0bb.png

✨ NEW: Prestige Upgrade “Golden Time”Once you get to Prestige Level 7 you can get a new feature: GOLDEN TIME!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606025/9e0e2fa082c1cdff240e6243986758264b69651b.png

Golden Time is a special state where Tears are worth 10x more, and comes with a new soundtrack (made by yours truly) and UI effects.

🌌 NEW MECHANIC: Transcendence
You’ve clicked, you’ve prestiged... now it’s time to transcend.

Transcendence is a late-game mechanic that permanently unlocks Transcendence Levels, used to access NEW power-ups.

You trascend... but sacrifice all Tears and Prestige to step into a new layer of gameplay.

It's a reset… but in another timeline (?!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606025/e05685016e3f02c70710dcef990b1083787c7629.png

👜 New Bags with Ridiculous Visuals

Unlocked via Transcendence, these bags aren’t just skins, they are bags from... another timeline?!?!

Demon Bag and Chad Bag are the first two transcendental cosmetics, and they come with custom animations and in-game effects.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606025/3014f6c3b37e1cd108df250e958d9505a1ffeab4.png

More are on the way! Collect them all and punch in style.


Oh, and of course... more achievements.

You may want to try the new patch to... Click to Punch.
